Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning maintenance inspections of on-site sewage systems.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to maintenance inspections of onsite sewagesystems; and adding a new section to chapter 70.05 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.05 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: If the state board of health or a local board of health requires anonsite sewage system with design flows of less than three thousandfive hundred gallons per day to be periodically inspected formaintenance and operation purposes, the local board of health mustprovide the option for the property owner, or the property owner'sdesignee, to perform the inspection. The local board of health shalladopt policies to determine the qualifications required for theproperty owner, or designee, to perform an inspection. The propertyowner, or designee, must be certified as a qualified inspector by thelocal board of health before he or she is authorized to perform theinspection.
